about: Missions picked in the garage, one at a time. The garage offers `offerCount` of them: always one class delivery, for the class driven least so far, and the rest drawn from the others. A mission stays chosen until it is done, then a fresh list is drawn; failing it costs nothing. Each `type` is checked by src/game/missions.js. `xp` is paid once, when it is done; class deliveries also scale by the class (XP_BY_CLASS).
